## Data

The data come from the [Office of the University Registrar](https://registrar.duke.edu/registration/enrollment-statistics).


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)

majors <- read_csv("data/majors.csv")

statsci_majors <- majors |>
  filter(
    department == "Statistical Science",
    academic_plan != "Minor"
  )
```
:::
